title_en: Evidential Reasoning Advances Interpretable Real-World Disease Screening
title_zh: 证据推理推进可解释的真实世界疾病筛查

sentences.en: Disease screening is critical for early detection and timely intervention in clinical practice.
sentences.zh: 疾病筛查对于临床实践中疾病的早期发现和及时干预至关重要。

sentences.en: However, most current screening models for medical images suffer from limited interpretability and suboptimal performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，目前大多数用于医学图像的筛查模型都存在可解释性有限和性能欠佳的问题。

sentences.en: They often lack effective mechanisms to reference historical cases or provide transparent reasoning pathways.
sentences.zh: 它们往往缺乏引用历史病例或提供透明推理路径的有效机制。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce EviScreen, an evidential reasoning framework for disease screening that leverages region-level evidence from historical cases.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些挑战，我们提出了 EviScreen，一个用于疾病筛查的证据推理框架，它利用来自历史病例的区域级证据。

sentences.en: The proposed EviScreen offers retrospection interpretability through regional evidence retrieved from dual knowledge banks.
sentences.zh: 所提出的 EviScreen 通过从双知识库中检索到的区域证据，提供了回溯性可解释性。

sentences.en: Using this evidential mechanism, the subsequent evidence-aware reasoning module makes predictions using both the current case and evidence from historical cases, thereby enhancing disease screening performance.
sentences.zh: 借助这一证据机制，随后的证据感知推理模块同时利用当前病例和历史病例的证据进行预测，从而提升疾病筛查性能。

sentences.en: Furthermore, rather than relying on post-hoc saliency maps, EviScreen enhances localization interpretability by leveraging abnormality maps derived from contrastive retrieval.
sentences.zh: 此外，EviScreen 不依赖事后显著性图，而是通过利用由对比检索得到的异常图来增强定位可解释性。

sentences.en: Our method achieves superior performance on our carefully established benchmarks for real-world disease screening, yielding notably higher specificity at clinical-level recall.
sentences.zh: 在我们精心构建的真实世界疾病筛查基准上，我们的方法取得了优越的性能，在临床级召回率下显著提高了特异度。

sentences.en: Code is publicly available at https://github.com/DopamineLcy/EviScreen.
sentences.zh: 代码公开可见于 https://github.com/DopamineLcy/EviScreen。

title_en: EVMbench: Evaluating AI Agents on Smart Contract Security
title_zh: EVMbench：评估 AI 智能体的智能合约安全能力

sentences.en: Smart contracts on public blockchains now manage large amounts of value, and vulnerabilities in these systems can lead to substantial losses.
sentences.zh: 公有区块链上的智能合约如今管理着大量价值，而这些系统中的漏洞可能导致巨额损失。

sentences.en: As AI agents become more capable at reading, writing, and running code, it is natural to ask how well they can already navigate this landscape, both in ways that improve security and in ways that might increase risk.
sentences.zh: 随着 AI 智能体在阅读、编写和运行代码方面的能力不断增强，人们自然会问：它们到目前为止在应对这一领域时表现如何——既包括提升安全的方面，也包括可能增加风险的方面。

sentences.en: We introduce EVMbench, an evaluation that measures the ability of agents to detect, patch, and exploit smart contract vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 EVMbench，一项用于衡量智能体检测、修补和利用智能合约漏洞能力的评估。

sentences.en: EVMbench draws on 117 curated vulnerabilities from 40 repositories and, in the most realistic setting, uses programmatic grading based on tests and blockchain state under a local Ethereum execution environment.
sentences.zh: EVMbench 汇集了来自 40 个代码仓库的 117 个精选漏洞，并在最贴近现实的设置中，基于本地以太坊执行环境下的测试和区块链状态进行程序化评分。

sentences.en: We evaluate a range of frontier agents and find that they are capable of discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities end-to-end against live blockchain instances.
sentences.zh: 我们评估了一系列前沿智能体，发现它们能够针对实时区块链实例端到端地发现并利用漏洞。

sentences.en: We release code, tasks, and tooling to support continued measurement of these capabilities and future work on security.
sentences.zh: 我们发布了代码、任务和工具，以支持对这些能力的持续衡量以及未来在安全方面的工作。

title_en: EvoC2F: Compiling Tool Orchestration for Efficient and Evolvable LLM Agents
title_zh: EvoC2F：编译工具编排，构建高效且可进化的大语言模型智能体

sentences.en: Tool-augmented language model agents have shown great potential in solving complex real-world tasks, but a key challenge remains balancing planning flexibility with the reliability required for production deployment.
sentences.zh: 工具增强的语言模型智能体在解决复杂的现实任务方面展现出巨大潜力，但一个关键挑战依然存在：如何在规划灵活性与生产部署所需的可靠性之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Existing approaches either execute tools sequentially without parallelism or generate unconstrained code, hindering optimization and verification.
sentences.zh: 现有方法要么无并行地顺序执行工具，要么生成不受约束的代码，从而阻碍了优化与验证。

sentences.en: Additionally, agents that learn from experience often suffer from skill library pollution, where unverified abstractions degrade performance over time.
sentences.zh: 此外，从经验中学习的智能体常常饱受技能库污染之苦——未经验证的抽象会随着时间推移而降低性能。

sentences.en: We propose EvoC2F, a framework that redefines tool orchestration through program compilation and verified continuous learning.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 EvoC2F，一个通过程序编译和经验证的持续学习来重新定义工具编排的框架。

sentences.en: By constraining plan generation to a well-defined intermediate representation with explicit semantic annotations, EvoC2F enables provably correct optimizations, parallelism, and fault tolerance, while ensuring soundness guarantees.
sentences.zh: 通过将规划生成约束为带有显式语义注释、定义良好的中间表示，EvoC2F 实现了可证明正确的优化、并行性和容错性，同时保证了健全性。

sentences.en: Our verification-gated code-to-function evolution process ensures that learned skills undergo rigorous testing before library admission.
sentences.zh: 我们以验证为门槛的代码到函数演化流程确保学习到的技能在进入技能库之前经过严格测试。

sentences.en: Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that EvoC2F outperforms existing methods, reducing latency and establishing a robust foundation for building reliable, evolving autonomous agents.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的实验表明，EvoC2F 优于现有方法，降低了延迟，并为构建可靠、可持续演化的自主智能体奠定了坚实基础。

title_en: EvoCF: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Agentic Memory-Driven Evolutionary Counterfactual Planning
title_zh: EvoCF：通过智能体记忆驱动的进化式反事实规划实现多智能体协作

sentences.en: Planning collaboration strategies for multi-agent embodied systems remains a core challenge for LLM-based planners, which often fail to capture the physical and coordination constraints of realworld environments.
sentences.zh: 为多智能体具身系统规划协作策略，对基于 LLM 的规划器而言仍是核心挑战，这些规划器往往无法捕捉现实环境中的物理与协调约束。

sentences.en: To address this, we present EvoCF, an agentic memory-driven evolutionary counterfactual planning framework for discovering improved multi-agent collaboration strategies through counterfactual plan generation and evaluation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 EvoCF，一个智能体记忆驱动的演化反事实规划框架，通过反事实规划生成与评估来发现更优的多智能体协作策略。

sentences.en: First, we propose a symbolic constraint inductor that induces reusable symbolic constraints from failures, forming an evolving rule library.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们提出了一种符号约束归纳器，它从失败中归纳出可复用的符号约束，形成持续演化的规则库。

sentences.en: Then, we propose an evolutionary counterfactual plan generator that systematically explores semantically consistent plan variants through rule-conditioned mutations, enabling robust collaboration strategies beyond short-sighted one-shot LLM plans.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们提出了一种演化式反事实规划生成器，它通过规则条件的变异系统地探索语义一致的规划变体，从而支持超越目光短浅的单次 LLM 规划的稳健协作策略。

sentences.en: Finally, we design an agentic memory-grounded evaluator that ranks candidate plans using retrieval-augmented evidence, producing interpretable, constraint-aware selections.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们设计了一个以智能体记忆为依托的评估器，它使用检索增强的证据对候选规划进行排序，产生可解释且感知约束的选择。

sentences.en: Across multi-agent embodied simulation benchmarks, EvoCF consistently discovers more robust and executable plans compared to baseline approaches.
sentences.zh: 在多智能体具身模拟基准上，与基线方法相比，EvoCF 持续发现更稳健、更可执行的规划。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate that grounding multi-agent planning in agentic memory and counterfactual reasoning significantly enhances both effectiveness and robustness.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，将多智能体规划建立在智能体记忆和反事实推理之上，能显著提升有效性和鲁棒性。

title_en: EvoClaw: Evaluating AI Agents on Continuous Software Evolution
title_zh: EvoClaw：评估 AI 智能体持续演化软件的能力

sentences.en: Real-world software must continuously evolve to meet ever-changing and open-ended requirements.
sentences.zh: 现实世界的软件必须持续演化，以满足不断变化且开放性的需求。

sentences.en: AI agents, increasingly deployed as long-running systems, are now entrusted to drive this evolution.
sentences.zh: AI 智能体日益被部署为长期运行的系统，如今被托付来推动这一演化。

sentences.en: Yet, existing benchmarks evaluate agents on isolated, one-off coding tasks, neglecting the temporal dependencies and technical debt inherent in real-world software evolution.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有基准在独立的一次性编码任务上评估智能体，忽视了现实软件演化中固有的时间依赖和技术债务。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepCommit, an agentic pipeline that reconstructs verifiable Milestone DAGs from noisy commit logs, where milestones are defined as functionally cohesive development goals.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 DeepCommit，一个智能体流水线，它从嘈杂的提交日志中重建可验证的里程碑 DAG（Milestone DAG），其中里程碑被定义为功能内聚的开发目标。

sentences.en: These executable sequences enable SWE-Milestone, a benchmark that evaluates agents on streams of milestone-level tasks, requiring them to sustain system integrity and limit error accumulation, dimensions of long-term software evolution largely missing from current benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 这些可执行的序列支撑起 SWE-Milestone，一个在里程碑级任务流上评估智能体的基准，要求它们维持系统完整性并限制错误累积——这些长期软件演化的维度在现有基准中大多缺失。

sentences.en: Our evaluation of 12 frontier models across 4 agent frameworks reveals a critical vulnerability: overall performance scores drop significantly from >80% on isolated tasks to at most 38% in continuous settings, exposing agents' profound struggle with long-term maintenance and error propagation.
sentences.zh: 我们对 4 个智能体框架中的 12 个前沿模型的评估揭示了一个严重弱点：整体性能得分从孤立任务上的 >80% 急剧下降到持续场景中的至多 38%，暴露出智能体在长期维护和错误传播方面的严重困境。

sentences.en: Project website: swe-milestone.com
sentences.zh: 项目网站：swe-milestone.com

title_en: EvoEGF-Mol: Evolving Exponential Geodesic Flow for Structure-based Drug Design
title_zh: EvoEGF-Mol：用于基于结构药物设计的演化指数测地流

sentences.en: Structure-Based Drug Design (SBDD) aims to discover bioactive ligands.
sentences.zh: 基于结构的药物设计（Structure-Based Drug Design, SBDD）旨在发现具有生物活性的配体。

sentences.en: Conventional approaches construct probability paths separately in Euclidean and probabilistic spaces for continuous atomic coordinates and discrete chemical categories, leading to a mismatch with the underlying statistical manifolds.
sentences.zh: 常规方法针对连续的原子坐标和离散的化学类别，分别在欧几里得空间和概率空间中构建概率路径，导致与底层统计流形不匹配。

sentences.en: We address this issue by representing molecules using composite exponential-family distributions, where coordinates and categories are represented within a unified natural parameter space to evolve synchronously along exponential geodesics under the Fisher-Rao metric.
sentences.zh: 我们通过使用复合指数族分布来表示分子来解决这一问题，其中坐标和类别在统一的自然参数空间内表示，并在 Fisher-Rao 度量下沿指数测地线同步演化。

sentences.en: To avoid the instantaneous trajectory collapse induced by geodesics directly targeting Dirac distributions, we propose Evolving Exponential Geodesic Flow for SBDD (EvoEGF-Mol), which replaces static Dirac targets with dynamically concentrating distributions and is trained with a progressive-parameter-refinement architecture.
sentences.zh: 为避免直接以 Dirac 分布为目标的测地线所引发的瞬时轨迹坍缩，我们提出了用于 SBDD 的演化指数测地流（EvoEGF-Mol），它用动态集中的分布取代静态的 Dirac 目标，并采用渐进式参数精化架构进行训练。

sentences.en: Our model approaches a reference-level PoseBusters passing rate (93.4%) on CrossDock, demonstrating remarkable geometric precision and interaction fidelity, while achieving superior performance over baseline methods on real-world MolGenBench tasks for bioactive scaffold recovery.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型在 CrossDock 上接近参考水平的 PoseBusters 通过率（93.4%），展现出卓越的几何精度和相互作用保真度，同时在真实世界的 MolGenBench 任务上，对于生物活性骨架恢复取得了优于基线方法的性能。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/BLEACH366/EvoEGF-Mol.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/BLEACH366/EvoEGF-Mol 获取。

title_en: EvoGM: Learning to Merge LLMs via Evolutionary Generative Optimization
title_zh: EvoGM：通过进化生成优化学习合并大语言模型

sentences.en: Evolutionary model merging provides a powerful framework for the automated, training-free composition of LLMs through parameter-space search.
sentences.zh: 进化模型合并为通过参数空间搜索实现无训练、自动化的LLM组合提供了强大的框架。

sentences.en: However, existing methods predominantly rely on stochastic, hand-crafted operators that overlook the underlying performance landscape of the coefficient space.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法主要依赖于随机的手工设计算子，这些算子忽视了系数空间底层的性能景观。

sentences.en: We propose Evolutionary Generative Merging (EvoGM), a framework that transcends manual heuristics by employing learnable generative modeling to optimize merging coefficients.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了进化生成合并（EvoGM），这是一个超越手工启发式方法的框架，通过采用可学习的生成建模来优化合并系数。

sentences.en: Specifically, EvoGM features a dual-generator architecture with cycle-consistent learning to adaptively sample and refine promising merging candidates.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，EvoGM采用双生成器架构，并结合循环一致性学习，以自适应地对有前景的合并候选进行采样与精炼。

sentences.en: By constructing winner-loser pairs from historical search trajectories, our framework effectively captures high-performance parameter distributions and maximizes data efficiency.
sentences.zh: 通过从历史搜索轨迹中构建胜者-败者配对，我们的框架能够有效捕获高性能参数分布，并最大化数据利用效率。

sentences.en: This generative process is seamlessly integrated into a multi-round evolutionary pipeline, where elite merged models iteratively serve as new expert foundations.
sentences.zh: 这一生成过程被无缝集成到多轮进化流程中，其中精英合并模型迭代地充当新的专家基础。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that EvoGM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, exhibiting robust performance on both seen and unseen tasks.
sentences.zh: 在多种基准上的大量实验表明，EvoGM显著优于最先进的基线方法，在已见与未见任务上均展现出稳健性能。

sentences.en: Code and data are available at https://github.com/JiangTao97/evogm.
sentences.zh: 代码与数据可在 https://github.com/JiangTao97/evogm 获取。

title_en: Evolution of Benchmark: Black-Box Optimization Benchmark Design through Large Language Model
title_zh: 基准的演化：通过大语言模型设计黑盒优化基准

sentences.en: Benchmark Design in Black-Box Optimization (BBO) is a fundamental yet open-ended topic.
sentences.zh: 黑盒优化（Black-Box Optimization, BBO）中的基准设计是一个基础但开放的研究课题。

sentences.en: Early BBO benchmarks are predominantly human-crafted, introducing expert bias and constraining diversity.
sentences.zh: 早期的 BBO 基准主要依赖人工构建，从而引入了专家偏差并限制了多样性。

sentences.en: Automating this design process can relieve the human-in-the-loop burden while enhancing diversity and objectivity.
sentences.zh: 将这一设计过程自动化，可以减轻人在回路的负担，同时增强多样性和客观性。

sentences.en: We propose Evolution of Benchmark (EoB), an automated BBO benchmark designer empowered by the large language model (LLM) and its program evolution capability.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了基准的演化（Evolution of Benchmark, EoB），一个由大语言模型（LLM）及其程序演化能力赋能的自动化 BBO 基准设计器。

sentences.en: Specifically, we formulate benchmark design as a bi-objective optimization problem towards maximizing (i) landscape similarity to target tasks and (ii) algorithm-differentiation ability across a portfolio of BBO solvers.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们将基准设计表述为一个双目标优化问题，目标是最大化（i）与目标任务的地形相似性，以及（ii）跨一组 BBO 求解器的算法区分能力。

sentences.en: Under this paradigm, EoB iteratively prompts LLM to evolve a population of benchmark programs and employs  a reflection-based scheme to co-evolve the landscape and its corresponding program.
sentences.zh: 在这一范式下，EoB 迭代地提示 LLM 演化一批基准程序，并采用基于反思的方案来共同演化地形及其对应的程序。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments validate our EoB is a competitive candidate in multi-dimensional usages: 1) Benchmarking BBO algorithms;
sentences.zh: 全面的实验验证了我们的 EoB 在多维用途上是一个有竞争力的候选方案：1）对 BBO 算法进行基准测试；

sentences.en: 2) Training and testing learning-assisted BBO algorithms;
sentences.zh: 2）训练和测试学习辅助的 BBO 算法；

sentences.en: 3) Extending proxy for expensive real-world problems.
sentences.zh: 3）为昂贵的现实世界问题扩展代理（proxy）。

title_en: Evolution Strategies at Scale: LLM Fine-Tuning Beyond Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 大规模进化策略：超越强化学习的大语言模型微调

sentences.en: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) for downstream tasks is an essential stage of modern AI deployment.
sentences.zh: 针对下游任务微调大语言模型（LLM）是现代 AI 部署中至关重要的阶段。

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as the dominant fine-tuning paradigm, underpinning many state-of-the-art LLMs.
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为占主导地位的微调范式，支撑着许多最先进的 LLM。

sentences.en: In contrast, evolution strategies (ES) has largely been overlooked due to the widespread belief that it does not scale to modern model sizes.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，演化策略（ES）在很大程度上被忽视，因为人们普遍认为它无法扩展到现代模型的规模。

sentences.en: This paper overturns this assumption by demonstrating the first successful application of ES to full-parameter fine-tuning of LLMs at the billion-parameter scale, without dimensionality reduction.
sentences.zh: 本文通过首次证明 ES 能够在不进行降维的情况下，成功应用于十亿参数规模 LLM 的全参数微调，从而推翻了这一假设。

sentences.en: ES can indeed search over extremely high-dimensional parameter spaces and outperform established RL implementations across multiple axes, including improved tolerance to long-horizon and delayed rewards, robustness across diverse base LLMs, reduced susceptibility to reward hacking, and improved training stability.
sentences.zh: ES 确实能够在极高维的参数空间中进行搜索，并在多个维度上优于已建立的 RL 实现，包括：对长视界和延迟奖励的容忍度更高、对多种基础 LLM 的鲁棒性更强、降低了对奖励黑客的敏感性，以及训练稳定性更佳。

sentences.en: These findings suggest that ES is not merely a viable alternative to RL, but a fundamentally different and powerful backpropagation-free post-training paradigm that opens a new direction for LLM fine-tuning beyond current RL-based approaches.
sentences.zh: 这些发现表明，ES 不仅是 RL 的可行替代方案，而且是一种本质上不同、强大的免反向传播的后训练范式，为超越现有基于 RL 方法的 LLM 微调开辟了新方向。

title_en: Evolution Strategies at the Hyperscale
title_zh: 超大规模进化策略

sentences.en: Evolution Strategies (ES) is a class of powerful black-box optimisation methods that are highly parallelisable and can handle non-differentiable and noisy objectives.
sentences.zh: 进化策略（Evolution Strategies, ES）是一类强大的黑盒优化方法，具有高度可并行性，并且能够处理不可微且有噪声的目标。

sentences.en: However, naïve ES becomes prohibitively expensive at scale on GPUs due to the low arithmetic intensity of batched matrix multiplications with unstructured random perturbations.
sentences.zh: 然而，在GPU上规模化运行时，朴素的ES由于采用非结构化随机扰动、批处理矩阵乘法的算术强度较低，而变得代价高昂、难以承受。

sentences.en: We introduce Evolution Guided GeneRal Optimisation via Low-rank Learning (EGGROLL), which improves arithmetic intensity by structuring individual perturbations as rank-$r$ matrices, resulting in a hundredfold increase in training speed for billion-parameter models at large population sizes, achieving up to 91\% of the throughput of pure batch inference.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了通过低秩学习实现的进化引导通用优化（EGGROLL），该方法将单个扰动结构化为秩为$r$的矩阵，从而提升算术强度，在大种群规模下为十亿参数模型带来百倍的训练速度提升，吞吐量最高可达纯批量推理的91\%。

sentences.en: We provide a rigorous theoretical analysis of ES for high-dimensional parameter objectives, investigating conditions needed for ES updates to converge in high dimensions, revealing a linearising effect, and proving consistency between EGGROLL and ES as parameter dimension increases.
sentences.zh: 我们针对高维参数目标提供了严谨的ES理论分析，考察了高维下ES更新收敛所需的条件，揭示了线性化效应，并证明随着参数维度增大，EGGROLL与ES之间的一致性。

sentences.en: Our experiments show that EGGROLL: (1) enables the stable pretraining of nonlinear recurrent language models that operate purely in integer datatypes, (2) is competitive with GRPO for post-training LLMs on reasoning tasks, and (3) does not compromise performance compared to ES in tabula rasa RL settings, despite being faster.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，EGGROLL：（1）能够稳定预训练完全以整数数据类型运行的非线性循环语言模型；（2）在推理任务的大语言模型post-training阶段可与GRPO相媲美；（3）在随机的强化学习（tabula rasa RL）设置中，虽然速度更快，但性能并不逊于ES。

title_en: Evolutionary Multi-View Classification with Label Noise via Gradient and Feature Dual-Perception
title_zh: 通过梯度与特征双重感知实现标签噪声下的进化多视图分类

sentences.en: This paper studies a fundamental yet often overlooked premise in evolutionary multi-view classification (EMVC): the impact of label noise on EMVC, such as distorting fitness landscapes shaped by individual fitness values (e.g., test accuracy).
sentences.zh: 本文研究进化多视角分类(EMVC)中一个基础却常被忽视的前提：标签噪声对EMVC的影响，例如扭曲由个体适应度值（如测试准确率）塑造的适应度景观。

sentences.en: Traditional EMVC assumes training labels are noise-free, yet this often fails in practice.
sentences.zh: 传统EMVC假设训练标签无噪声，但这在实践中常常不成立。

sentences.en: As a result, label noise introduces harmful supervision during the training phase, resulting in distorted fitness landscapes and the emergence of fitness evaluation bias (FEB).
sentences.zh: 因此，标签噪声在训练阶段引入了有害的监督，导致适应度景观失真并产生适应度评估偏差(FEB)。

sentences.en: This bias misguides the evolutionary trajectory, causing the search process to stagnate in local optima.
sentences.zh: 这一偏差误导了进化轨迹，使搜索过程停滞在局部最优。

sentences.en: Given that label noise largely stems from the mislabeling of samples near their decision boundaries by human annotators, we thus compared the decision boundaries of human annotators and models, and found discrepancies between the two.
sentences.zh: 鉴于标签噪声很大程度上源于人工标注者对接近决策边界样本的错误标注，我们比较了人工标注者与模型的决策边界，并发现两者之间存在差异。

sentences.en: Based on this observation, we propose a simple yet effective ``detect-then-calibrate" data purification framework that leverages outlier analysis in the gradient space (i.e., treating outliers as noisy samples) and prototype calibration in the feature space (i.e., utilizing feature prototypes of noise-free samples to correct the labels of noisy samples).
sentences.zh: 基于这一观察，我们提出一个简单而有效的“检测然后校准”数据净化框架，该框架利用梯度空间中的离群点分析（即将离群点视为噪声样本）以及特征空间中的原型校准（即利用无噪声样本的特征原型来修正噪声样本的标签）。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that this strategy can effectively purify the data and alleviate FEB; furthermore, it can improve the performance of various multi-view learning paradigms in label noise scenarios.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，该策略能有效净化数据并缓解FEB；此外，它还能在标签噪声场景下提升多种多视角学习范式的性能。

sentences.en: (The code will be published.)
sentences.zh: （代码将予以发布。）

title_en: Evolving Interdependent Operators with Large Language Models for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization
title_zh: 利用大语言模型进化相互依赖的算子，以进行多目标组合优化

sentences.en: Neighborhood search operators are critical to the performance of Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms (MOEAs) and rely heavily on expert design.
sentences.zh: 邻域搜索算子对多目标进化算法（MOEA）的性能至关重要，且高度依赖专家设计。

sentences.en: Although recent LLM-based Automated Heuristic Design (AHD) methods have made notable progress, they primarily optimize individual heuristics or components independently, lacking explicit exploration and exploitation of dynamic coupling relationships between operators.
sentences.zh: 尽管近期基于LLM的自动启发式设计（AHD）方法已取得显著进展，但它们主要独立地优化单个启发式或组件，缺乏对算子之间动态耦合关系的显式探索与利用。

sentences.en: In this paper, multi-operator optimization in MOEAs is formulated as a Markov decision process, enabling the improvement of interdependent operators through sequential decision-making.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们将MOEA中的多算子优化表述为马尔可夫决策过程，从而能够通过序贯决策来改进相互依赖的算子。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose the Evolution of Operator Combination (E2OC) framework for MOEAs, which achieves the co-evolution of design strategies and executable codes.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了面向MOEA的算子组合进化（E2OC）框架，实现设计策略与可执行代码的协同进化。

sentences.en: E2OC employs Monte Carlo Tree Search to progressively search combinations of operator design strategies and adopts an operator rotation mechanism to identify effective operator configurations while supporting the integration of mainstream AHD methods as the underlying designer.
sentences.zh: E2OC采用蒙特卡洛树搜索来逐步搜索算子设计策略的组合，并引入算子轮换机制来识别有效的算子配置，同时支持将主流AHD方法集成作为底层设计器。

sentences.en: Experimental results across AHD tasks with varying objectives and problem scales show that E2OC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art AHD and other multi-heuristic co-design frameworks, demonstrating strong generalization and sustained optimization capability.
sentences.zh: 在目标与问题规模各异的AHD任务上的实验结果表明，E2OC始终优于最先进的AHD方法及其他多种启发式协同设计框架，展现出强大的泛化能力与持续的优化能力。

title_en: Evolving Interpretable Constitutions for Multi-Agent Coordination
title_zh: 进化可解释的多智能体协调宪法

sentences.en: Constitutional AI has focused on single-model alignment using fixed principles.
sentences.zh: 宪法式AI（Constitutional AI）专注于使用固定原则进行单模型对齐。

sentences.en: However, multi-agent systems create novel alignment challenges through emergent social dynamics.
sentences.zh: 然而，多智能体系统通过涌现的社会动态带来了新颖的对齐挑战。

sentences.en: We present Constitutional Evolution, a framework for automatically discovering behavioral norms in multi-agent LLM systems.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了宪法进化（Constitutional Evolution），这是一个在多智能体LLM系统中自动发现行为规范的框架。

sentences.en: Using a grid-world simulation with survival pressure, we study the tension between individual and collective welfare, quantified via a Societal Stability Score $\mathcal{S} \in [0,1]$ that combines productivity, survival, and conflict metrics.
sentences.zh: 利用带有生存压力的网格世界模拟，我们研究了个体福祉与集体福祉之间的张力，并通过社会稳定性评分$\mathcal{S} \in [0,1]$对其进行量化，该评分综合了生产力、生存与冲突指标。

sentences.en: Adversarial constitutions lead to societal collapse ($\mathcal{S}=0$), while vague prosocial principles (''be helpful, harmless, honest'') produce inconsistent coordination ($\mathcal{S}=0.249$).
sentences.zh: 对抗性宪法会导致社会崩溃（$\mathcal{S}=0$），而模糊的利他原则（“be helpful, harmless, honest”）则会产生不一致的协调（$\mathcal{S}=0.249$）。

sentences.en: Even constitutions designed by Claude 4.5 Opus with explicit knowledge of the objective achieve only moderate performance ($\mathcal{S}=0.332$).
sentences.zh: 即使是由Claude 4.5 Opus设计的、明确了解目标的宪法，也仅能取得中等性能（$\mathcal{S}=0.332$）。

sentences.en: Using LLM-driven genetic programming with multi-island evolution, we evolve constitutions maximizing social welfare without explicit guidance toward cooperation.
sentences.zh: 我们利用LLM驱动的遗传编程与多岛屿进化来演进宪法，使其在无需显式合作引导的情况下最大化社会福利。

sentences.en: The evolved constitution $\mathcal{C}^*$ achieves  $\mathcal{S}=0.556\pm0.008$ (123\% higher than human-designed baselines, $N=10$), eliminates conflict, and discovers that minimizing communication (0.9\% vs 62.2\% social actions) outperforms verbose coordination.
sentences.zh: 进化得到的宪法$\mathcal{C}^*$取得了$\mathcal{S}=0.556\pm0.008$（比人工设计的基线高123\%，$N=10$），消除了冲突，并发现最小化通信（0.9\%对比62.2\%的社交行为）优于冗长的协调。

sentences.en: Our interpretable  rules demonstrate that cooperative norms can be discovered rather than prescribed.
sentences.zh: 我们可解释的规则表明，合作规范是可以被发现的，而非必须被预先规定。

title_en: Evolving Quantitative Reasoning through Self-Play in Digital Twin Markets
title_zh: 通过数字孪生市场中的自博弈进化定量推理能力

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities in high-level semantic reasoning and strategic planning, making them appealing for complex decision-making tasks; however, their quantitative reasoning remains unreliable despite recent progress in tool-augmented and structured inference.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在高层次语义推理和战略规划方面展现出强大的能力，使其对复杂决策任务极具吸引力；然而，尽管在工具增强和结构化推理方面取得了进展，它们的定量推理仍然不够可靠。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we decouple reasoning from computation by assigning LLMs to planning, analysis, and result interpretation, while delegating numerical computation and statistical inference to specialized external tools.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一局限，我们将推理与计算解耦，让 LLM 负责规划、分析和结果解读，同时将数值计算与统计推断委托给专门的外部工具。

sentences.en: Rather than being hard-coded, these tools are constructed in a constrained and structured manner during planning as explicit intermediate reasoning artifacts, enabling adaptive and scenario-dependent quantitative reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这些工具并非硬编码，而是在规划过程中以受约束、结构化的方式作为显式的中间推理产物被构建，从而支持自适应、依场景而变的定量推理。

sentences.en: LLMs iteratively analyze tool outputs under diverse market conditions and leverage performance-based feedback to refine subsequent tool selection and construction, thereby forming a bounded self-evolving loop.
sentences.zh: LLM 在不同市场条件下迭代分析工具输出，并利用基于性能的反馈来改进随后的工具选择与构建，由此形成一个有界的自演化循环。

sentences.en: We instantiate this process through self-play in a controllable digital twin market, DecoupledMarket, where LLM agents continuously test, compare, and adapt their strategies.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在可控数字孪生市场 DecoupledMarket 中的自我对弈来实例化这一过程，LLM 智能体在其中持续测试、比较并调整其策略。

sentences.en: By coupling high-level planning with robust quantitative execution, the proposed framework enhances the quantitative reliability of LLM-driven decision-making.
sentences.zh: 通过将高层规划与稳健的定量执行相结合，所提出的框架提升了 LLM 驱动决策的定量可靠性。

sentences.en: All code and data are available at https://github.com/MTMQuantAI/Agent-Trading-Arena.git.
sentences.zh: 所有代码与数据可在 https://github.com/MTMQuantAI/Agent-Trading-Arena.git 获取。

title_en: EVOLVING ROLLOUTS: Harnessing Historical Experience for Web Agent Evolution in Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: EVOLVING ROLLOUTS：利用历史经验实现强化学习中网页智能体的进化

sentences.en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) for web search is prohibitively expensive due to long context lengths and costly environment interactions, and this inefficiency is further exacerbated by group-based optimization, which discards learning signals from entire rollout groups with zero reward variance.
sentences.zh: 用于网络搜索的智能体强化学习（RL）由于上下文长度长、环境交互代价高昂而成本高得难以承受，而基于组的优化进一步加剧了这一低效问题，因为它会丢弃整组零奖励方差回放中所包含的学习信号。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose EVOLVING ROLLOUTS, an RL framework for web-search agents that moves beyond episodic training and distills collected rollouts into in-context guidance for future policy behavior.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出演化回放（EVOLVING ROLLOUTS）框架，这是一个面向网络搜索智能体的 RL 框架，它超越回合式训练，将收集到的回放蒸馏为上下文内的指导，以引导未来的策略行为。

sentences.en: By extracting the reward-labeled trajectories into strategic experiences, our method augments standard parameter-space optimization with implicit context-space optimization guided by prior experience.
sentences.zh: 通过提取带奖励标注的轨迹作为策略性经验，我们的方法在标准的参数空间优化之上，叠加了由先前经验引导的隐式上下文空间优化。

sentences.en: This enables the agent to recover learning signals from zero-variance rollouts, thereby fostering co-evolution between the policy and the experience repository.
sentences.zh: 这使得智能体能够从零方差回放中恢复学习信号，从而促进策略与经验库之间的协同演化。

sentences.en: EVOLVING ROLLOUTS improves sample efficiency and task performance across representative web search benchmarks, with Qwen3-8B surpassing the much larger Qwen3-30B-A3B in average performance across GAIA, xBench, and HLE, and Qwen3-4B attaining comparable results on GAIA and HLE.
sentences.zh: 演化回放在多个代表性网络搜索基准上提升了样本效率与任务性能，其中 Qwen3-8B 在 GAIA、xBench 和 HLE 上的平均性能超越了规模更大的 Qwen3-30B-A3B，而 Qwen3-4B 在 GAIA 和 HLE 上也取得了相当的结果。

title_en: EvoMAS: Evolutionary Generation of Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: EvoMAS：进化生成多智能体系统

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) show strong promise for complex reasoning, planning, and tool-augmented tasks, but designing effective MAS architectures remains labor-intensive, brittle, and hard to generalize.
sentences.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）在复杂推理、规划与工具增强任务上展现出巨大潜力，但设计有效的MAS架构仍然劳动密集、脆弱且难以泛化。

sentences.en: Existing automatic MAS generation methods either rely on code generation, which often leads to executability and robustness failures, or impose rigid architectural templates that limit expressiveness and adaptability.
sentences.zh: 现有的自动MAS生成方法要么依赖代码生成，而代码生成常常导致可执行性与鲁棒性的失败；要么施加僵化的架构模板，限制了表达力与适应性。

sentences.en: We propose Evolutionary Generation of Multi-Agent Systems (EvoMAS), which formulates MAS generation as structured configuration generation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了多智能体系统的进化生成方法（EvoMAS），它将MAS生成表述为结构化配置生成问题。

sentences.en: EvoMAS performs evolutionary generation in configuration space.
sentences.zh: EvoMAS在配置空间中进行进化生成。

sentences.en: Specifically, EvoMAS selects initial configurations from a pool, applies feedback-conditioned mutation and crossover guided by execution traces, and iteratively refines both the candidate pool and an experience memory.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，EvoMAS从一个池中选取初始配置，应用由执行轨迹引导的反馈条件化变异与交叉，并迭代地精炼候选池与经验记忆。

sentences.en: We evaluate EvoMAS on diverse benchmarks, including BBEH, SWE-Bench, and WorkBench, covering reasoning, software engineering, and tool-use tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们在多种基准上评估EvoMAS，包括BBEH、SWE-Bench与WorkBench，覆盖推理、软件工程与工具使用等任务。

sentences.en: EvoMAS consistently improves task performance over both human-designed MAS and prior automatic MAS generation methods, while producing generated systems with higher executability and runtime robustness.
sentences.zh: EvoMAS在任务性能上持续优于人工设计的MAS以及先前的自动MAS生成方法，同时生成的系统具有更高的可执行性与运行时鲁棒性。

sentences.en: EvoMAS outperforms the agent evolution method EvoAgent by +10.5 points on BBEH reasoning and +7.1 points on WorkBench.
sentences.zh: 在BBEH推理上，EvoMAS比智能体进化方法EvoAgent高出+10.5分，在WorkBench上高出+7.1分。

sentences.en: With Claude-4.5-Sonnet, EvoMAS also reaches 79.1% on SWE-Bench-Verified, matching the top of the leaderboard.
sentences.zh: 借助Claude-4.5-Sonnet，EvoMAS在SWE-Bench-Verified上还达到了79.1%，与排行榜榜首持平。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/amazon-science/EvoMAS
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/amazon-science/EvoMAS 获取。

title_en: EvoMAS: Heuristics in the Loop—Evolving Smarter Agentic Workflows
title_zh: EvoMAS：让启发式方法进入循环，进化出更智能的智能体工作流

sentences.en: The rapid development of Large Language Models has driven Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) growth, but constructing efficient MAS requires labor-intensive manual design.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型的快速发展推动了多智能体系统（MAS）的成长，但构建高效的MAS需要劳动密集的人工设计。

sentences.en: Current automation methods generate templated agents, use monolithic optimization, and ignore task complexity gradients.
sentences.zh: 当前的自动化方法生成模板化的智能体，采用整体式优化，并忽略了任务复杂度的梯度。

sentences.en: This paper presents Evolutionary MAS (EvoMAS), a biologically-inspired framework whose core is a dynamic and diverse repertoire of seven evolutionary strategies---six biologically-inspired operators (3 exploration, 3 exploitation) together with a custom operator for domain-specific transformations---driven by adaptive strategy selection.
sentences.zh: 本文提出了进化MAS（EvoMAS），这是一个受生物学启发的框架，其核心是一个由七种进化策略组成的动态且多样化的策略库——包括六个受生物学启发的算子（3个探索、3个利用）以及一个用于特定领域变换的自定义算子——并由自适应策略选择所驱动。

sentences.en: These are complemented by role-level evolution that refines agent specialization and collaboration patterns, and a curriculum-guided schedule that evolves workflows from simple to complex tasks with cross-stage stability.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有角色级进化来精炼智能体的专业化与协作模式，以及一个课程引导的调度机制，使工作流从简单任务演进到复杂任务并保持跨阶段稳定性。

sentences.en: Additionally, to resolve the contradiction between the inefficiency of pure evolution and the rigidity of manual design, we introduce the *Cyber Creator*, a meta-controller that conducts heuristics-in-the-loop learning by formulating and reflectively updating evolutionary rules and strategies.
sentences.zh: 此外，为了解决纯进化效率低下与人工设计僵化之间的矛盾，我们引入了*Cyber Creator*，这是一个元控制器，通过制定并反思性地更新进化规则与策略来进行人在环中的启发式学习。

sentences.en: Evaluations demonstrate that EvoMAS consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple domains while maintaining cost efficiency, with roles evolving from homogeneous actors to specialized reasoning ensembles.
sentences.zh: 评估表明，EvoMAS在多个领域持续优于现有方法，同时保持成本效率，其角色从同质化的行动者演化为专门化的推理集合体。

title_en: EvReflection: Event-Driven Micro-Dynamics for Reflection Removal
title_zh: EvReflection：用于反射去除的事件驱动微动态

sentences.en: Despite remarkable progress in reflection removal, current methods primarily exploit static image priors from a single frame and still suffer from severe residual artifacts due to the inherent ambiguity between the reflection and transmission layers.
sentences.zh: 尽管反射去除已取得显著进展，但现有方法主要利用单帧图像中的静态图像先验，且由于反射层与透射层之间固有的歧义性，仍会留下严重的残留伪影。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose leveraging event signals to break this ambiguity.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出利用事件信号来打破这种歧义性。

sentences.en: By employing event cameras to capture micro-dynamics, we reveal the differential motion between these two layers.
sentences.zh: 通过采用事件相机捕获微动力学，我们揭示了这两层之间的差异运动。

sentences.en: We thereby present a novel event-driven reflection removal network, EvReflection, that utilizes these dynamic cues for layer separation.
sentences.zh: 由此我们提出了一种新颖的事件驱动反射去除网络EvReflection，利用这些动态线索进行层分离。

sentences.en: Specifically, we design a Micro-Dynamics Decoupler to disentangle layer-specific motions from event streams as priors, which then guide a Parallax-Attention Rectifier to cleanly remove artifacts from the RGB image.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们设计了一个微动力学解耦器（Micro-Dynamics Decoupler），从事件流中解耦出各层特有的运动作为先验，继而引导视差注意力矫正器（Parallax-Attention Rectifier）干净地去除RGB图像中的伪影。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to address data scarcity, we develop a parallax-aware simulation pipeline and construct the EVR$^2$ benchmark dataset, the first real-world dataset for this task.
sentences.zh: 此外，为解决数据稀缺问题，我们开发了一条视差感知的仿真流程，并构建了EVR$^2$基准数据集，这是该任务首个真实世界数据集。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that EvReflection achieves state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks, surpassing the best competing method by more than 1.6 dB and 1.2 dB in PSNR, respectively.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，EvReflection在合成与真实世界基准上都达到了最先进性能，在PSNR上分别比最优的竞争方法高出1.6 dB和1.2 dB。

sentences.en: The code, dataset, and pre-trained models are available at \href{https://github.com/JiaxiaoWang/EvReflection}{https://github.com/JiaxiaoWang/EvReflection}.
sentences.zh: 代码、数据集与预训练模型可在 \href{https://github.com/JiaxiaoWang/EvReflection}{https://github.com/JiaxiaoWang/EvReflection} 获取。

title_en: Exact and Approximate Algorithms for Polytree Learning
title_zh: 多树学习的精确与近似算法

sentences.en: Polytrees are a subclass of Bayesian networks that seek to capture the conditional dependencies between a set of $n$ variables as a directed forest and are motivated by their more efficient inference and improved interpretability.
sentences.zh: 多树（Polytrees）是贝叶斯网络的一个子类，旨在将一组$n$个变量之间的条件依赖关系表示为有向森林，其优势在于推理效率更高且可解释性更好。

sentences.en: Since the problem of learning the best polytree is NP-hard, we study which restrictions make it more tractable by considering for example in-degree bounds, properties of score functions measuring the quality of a polytree, and approximation algorithms.
sentences.zh: 由于学习最优多树是NP困难问题，我们研究哪些限制条件能使其更易处理，例如考虑入度上界、衡量多树质量的得分函数的性质，以及近似算法。

sentences.en: We devise an algorithm that finds the optimal polytree in time $\mathcal{O}((2+\epsilon)^n)$ for arbitrarily small $\epsilon > 0 $ and any constant in-degree bound $k$, improving over the fastest previously known algorithm of time complexity $\mathcal{O}(3^n)$.
sentences.zh: 我们设计了一种算法，对于任意足够小$\epsilon > 0$和任意常数入度上界$k$，能在$\mathcal{O}((2+\epsilon)^n)$时间内找到最优多树，优于此前最快的$\mathcal{O}(3^n)$时间复杂度算法。

sentences.en: We further give polynomial-time algorithms for finding a polytree whose score is within a factor of $k$ from the optimal one for arbitrary scores and a factor of $2$ for additive ones.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步给出了多项式时间算法，对于任意得分函数，能够找到得分与最优解相差不超过因子$k$的多树；对于可加性得分，该因子为2。

sentences.en: Many of the results are complemented by (nearly) tight lower bounds for either the time complexity or the approximation factors.
sentences.zh: 许多结果还配以针对时间复杂度或近似因子的（近乎）紧的下界。

title_en: Exact Functional ANOVA Decomposition for Categorical Inputs
title_zh: 类别输入的精确函数方差分析分解

sentences.en: Functional ANOVA offers a principled framework for interpretability by decomposing a model’s prediction into main effects and higher-order interactions.
sentences.zh: 函数化方差分析（Functional ANOVA）通过将模型的预测分解为主效应与高阶交互，为可解释性提供了严谨的框架。

sentences.en: For independent features, this decomposition is well-defined, strongly linked with SHAP values, and serves as a cornerstone of additive explainability.
sentences.zh: 对于独立特征，这种分解有明确定义、与SHAP值紧密关联，并构成加性可解释性的基石。

sentences.en: However, the lack of an explicit closed-form expression for general dependent distributions has forced practitioners to rely on costly sampling-based approximations.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于一般依赖分布缺乏显式闭式表达式，迫使实践者依赖于代价高昂的基于采样的近似方法。

sentences.en: We completely resolve this limitation for categorical inputs.
sentences.zh: 针对类别输入，我们彻底解决了这一局限。

sentences.en: By bridging functional analysis with the extension of discrete Fourier analysis, we derive a closed-form decomposition without any assumption.
sentences.zh: 通过将泛函分析与离散傅里叶分析的推广相衔接，我们推导出无需任何假设的闭式分解。

sentences.en: Our formulation is computationally very efficient.
sentences.zh: 我们的公式在计算上非常高效。

sentences.en: It seamlessly recovers the classical independent case and extends to arbitrary dependence structures, including distributions with non-rectangular support.
sentences.zh: 它能够无缝地恢复经典独立情形，并扩展到任意的依赖结构，包括具有非矩形支撑的分布。

sentences.en: Furthermore, leveraging the intrinsic link between SHAP and ANOVA under independence, our framework yields a natural generalization of SHAP values for the general categorical setting.
sentences.zh: 此外，利用独立情形下SHAP与ANOVA之间的内在联系，我们的框架为一般类别设定提供了一种SHAP值的自然推广。

title_en: Exact Unlearning in Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 强化学习中的精确遗忘学习

sentences.en: We formulate the problem of \emph{exact unlearning} in reinforcement learning, where the goal is to design an efficient framework that enables the removal of any user’s data upon deletion request, i.e., the online learner’s output after unlearning be \emph{indistinguishable} from what would have been produced had the deleted user never interacted with the learner.
sentences.zh: 我们形式化了强化学习中的“精确遗忘”问题，其目标在于设计一个高效框架，使得在收到删除请求时能够移除任何用户的数据，即遗忘后在线学习器的输出应与若被删除用户从未与学习器交互过时所产生的结果不可区分。

sentences.en: For any $\rho >0$, we show that there exists a reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that is $\rho$-TV-stable and supports an exact unlearning procedure whose expected computational cost is only a $\rho \sqrt{\ln T}$ fraction of the computational cost of retraining from scratch.
sentences.zh: 对于任意$\rho > 0$，我们证明存在一种强化学习（RL）算法，它是$\rho$-TV稳定的，并支持一种精确遗忘过程，其期望计算成本仅为从头重训练计算成本的$\rho \sqrt{\ln T}$倍。

sentences.en: We construct such a $\rho$-TV-stable RL algorithm for tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs), which achieves a regret bound of  $\mathcal{O}(H^2 \sqrt{SAT} + H^3 S^2 A + {H^{2.5} S^2 A}/{\rho})$, where $S, A, H$, and $T$ denote the number of states, the number of actions, the episode horizon, and the number of episodes, respectively.
sentences.zh: 我们为表格马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）构造了这样一个$\rho$-TV稳定的RL算法，其遗憾界为$\mathcal{O}(H^2 \sqrt{SAT} + H^3 S^2 A + {H^{2.5} S^2 A}/\rho)$，其中$S, A, H$与$T$分别表示状态数、动作数、回合长度与回合数。

sentences.en: We also establish a lower bound of $\Omega(H\sqrt{SAT}+{SAH}/{\rho})$  for $\rho$-TV-stable RL algorithms,  showing that our algorithm is nearly minimax optimal.
sentences.zh: 我们还为$\rho$-TV稳定的RL算法建立了$\Omega(H\sqrt{SAT}+{SAH}/\rho)$的下界，表明我们的算法几乎达到极小极大最优。

title_en: Exactly Computing do-Shapley Values
title_zh: 精确计算 do-Shapley 值

sentences.en: Structural Causal Models (SCM) are a powerful framework for describing complicated dynamics across the natural sciences.
sentences.zh: 结构因果模型（SCM）是描述自然科学中复杂动态的强大框架。

sentences.en: A particularly elegant way of interpreting SCMs is via do-Shapley values, a game-theoretic method of quantifying the average effect of $d$ variables across exponentially many interventions.
sentences.zh: 解释SCM的一种特别优雅的方式是通过do-Shapley值，这是一种博弈论方法，用于量化跨指数级干预下$d$个变量的平均效应。

sentences.en: Like Shapley values, computing do-Shapley values generally requires evaluating exponentially many terms.
sentences.zh: 与Shapley值一样，计算do-Shapley值通常需要评估指数级数量的项。

sentences.en: The foundation of our work is a reformulation of do-Shapley values in terms of the irreducible sets of the underlying SCM.
sentences.zh: 我们工作的基础是将do-Shapley值基于底层SCM的不可约集合进行重新表述。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we can exactly compute do-Shapley values in time linear in the number of irreducible sets $r$, which itself can range from $d$ to $2^d$ depending on the graph structure of the SCM.
sentences.zh: 利用这一洞见，我们能够在与不可约集合数量$r$成线性关系的时间内精确计算do-Shapley值，而$r$本身随SCM的图结构不同可在$d$到$2^d$之间变化。

sentences.en: Since $r$ is unknown a priori, we complement the exact algorithm with an estimator that, like general Shapley value estimators, can be run with any query budget.
sentences.zh: 由于$r$先验未知，我们用一个估计器对精确算法进行补充，该估计器与一般的Shapley值估计器一样，可在任意查询预算下运行。

sentences.en: As the query budget approaches $r$, our estimators can produce more accurate estimates than prior methods by several orders of magnitude, and, when the budget reaches $r$, return the Shapley values up to machine precision.
sentences.zh: 当查询预算趋近于$r$时，我们的估计器能够产生比先前方法精确数个数量级的估计结果；而当预算达到$r$时，则能在机器精度内返回Shapley值。

sentences.en: Beyond computational speed, we also reduce the identification burden: we prove that non-parametric identifiability of do-Shapley values requires only the identification of interventional effects for the $d$ singleton coalitions, rather than all classes.
sentences.zh: 除计算速度外，我们还降低了辨识负担：我们证明，do-Shapley值的非参数可辨识性仅需要辨识$d$个单元素联盟的干预效应，而无需辨识所有类别的干预效应。

title_en: Excited Pfaffians: Generalized Neural Wave Functions Across Structure and State
title_zh: 激发态 Pfaffian：跨结构与状态的广义神经波函数

sentences.en: Neural-network wave functions in Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) have achieved great success in accurately representing both ground and excited states.
sentences.zh: 变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）中的神经网络波函数在准确表征基态与激发态方面已取得巨大成功。

sentences.en: However, achieving sufficient numerical accuracy of state overlaps requires growing the number of Monte Carlo samples, and consequently computational cost, with the number of states.
sentences.zh: 然而，要实现对状态重叠的足够数值精度，需要随状态数量增长而增加蒙特卡洛采样数，进而增大计算成本。

sentences.en: We present a nearly constant sample size approach named Multi-State Importance Sampling (MSIS), which leverages all states' samples to estimate any pairwise overlap.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种样本量几乎恒定的方法——多态重要性采样（MSIS），它利用所有状态的样本来估计任意两两之间的重叠。

sentences.en: To efficiently evaluate all states for all samples, we introduce Excited Pfaffians.
sentences.zh: 为高效地对所有样本评估所有状态，我们引入了激发态Pfaffians。

sentences.en: Inspired by Hartree-Fock, this architecture represents many states within a single neural network.
sentences.zh: 受Hartree-Fock启发，这一架构能够在单个神经网络内表示多个状态。

sentences.en: Excited Pfaffians also serve as generalized wave functions, allowing a single model to represent multi-state potential energy surfaces.
sentences.zh: 激发态Pfaffians还可充当广义波函数，使单一模型能够表示多态势能面。

sentences.en: On the carbon dimer, we match the $\mathcal{O}(N_s^4)$-scaling natural excited states while training $>200\times$ faster and modeling 50% more states.
sentences.zh: 在碳二聚体上，我们匹配了$\mathcal{O}(N_s^4)$标度的自然激发态，同时训练速度快200余倍，并构建了多出50%的状态模型。

sentences.en: Our favorable scaling enables us to be the first to use neural networks to find all distinct energy levels of the Beryllium atom.
sentences.zh: 我们有利的标度使我们成为首个利用神经网络找出铍原子所有不同能级的研究团队。

sentences.en: Finally, we demonstrate that a single wave function can represent excited states across various molecules.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们证明，单一波函数可以表征多种分子中的激发态。

title_en: ExCyTIn-Bench: Evaluating LLM agents on Cyber Threat Investigation
title_zh: ExCyTIn-Bench：评估大语言模型智能体的网络威胁调查能力

sentences.en: We present ExCyTIn-Bench, the first benchmark to Evaluate an LLM agent X on the task of Cyber Threat Investigation through security questions derived from investigation graphs.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了ExCyTIn-Bench，这是首个通过基于调查图生成的安全问题来评估LLM智能体X在网络威胁调查任务上表现的基准。

sentences.en: Real‑world security analysts must sift through a large number of heterogeneous security logs, follow multi‑hop chains of evidence to investigate threats.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的安全分析师必须筛选大量异构安全日志，遵循多跳证据链来调查威胁。

sentences.en: With the developments of LLMs, building LLM-based agents for automatic threat investigation is a promising direction.
sentences.zh: 随着LLM的发展，构建基于LLM的智能体以实现自动化威胁调查是一个有前景的方向。

sentences.en: We construct a benchmark from a controlled Azure tenant including a SQL environment covering 57 log tables from Microsoft Sentinel and related services, and 7542 generated questions.
sentences.zh: 我们基于一个受控的Azure租户构建了该基准，其中包含一个涵盖Microsoft Sentinel及相关服务57张日志表的SQL环境，以及7542个生成的问题。

sentences.en: We leverage security logs extracted with expert-crafted detection logic to build threat investigation graphs, and then generate questions with LLMs using paired nodes on the graph, taking the start node as background context and the end node as answer.
sentences.zh: 我们利用由专家精心设计的检测逻辑提取的安全日志来构建威胁调查图，然后使用LLM基于图上的成对节点生成问题，以起始节点作为背景上下文，以结束节点作为答案。

sentences.en: Anchoring each question to these explicit nodes and edges not only provides automatic, explainable ground truth answers but also makes the pipeline reusable and readily extensible to new logs.
sentences.zh: 将每个问题锚定到这些显式的节点与边上，不仅提供了自动、可解释的真值答案，还使该流程可复用，并能方便地扩展到新的日志。

sentences.en: Our comprehensive experiments on the test set with different models confirm the difficulty of the task: the best model so far can achieve a reward of 0.606, leaving much headroom for future research.
sentences.zh: 我们在测试集上针对不同模型进行的综合实验证实了该任务的难度：目前最好的模型也只能达到0.606的奖励，为未来研究留下了充足的空间。

title_en: Executable Agentic Memory for GUI Agent
title_zh: 用于图形界面智能体的可执行智能体记忆

sentences.en: Modern GUI agents typically rely on a model-centric and step-wise interaction paradigm, where LLMs must re-interpret the UI and re-decide actions at every screen, which is fragile in long-horizon tasks.
sentences.zh: 现代GUI智能体通常依赖以模型为中心、逐步骤交互的范式，即LLM必须在每一屏重新解读UI并重新决定动作，这在长时程任务中较为脆弱。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Executable Agentic Memory (EAM), a structured Knowledge Graph (KG) that shifts GUI planning from free-form generation to a robust retrieval-and-execution process.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了可执行智能体记忆（EAM），这是一种结构化的知识图谱（KG），它将GUI规划从自由形式生成转变为稳健的检索与执行流程。

sentences.en: Our approach includes a sample-efficient memory construction pipeline using state-aware DFS and action-group mining to compress multi-step routines.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法包括一个样本高效的记忆构建流程，利用状态感知的DFS与动作组挖掘来压缩多步骤例程。

sentences.en: To ensure efficient planning, we introduce a value-guided graph search where a lightweight Q-function model steers Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) over the KG.
sentences.zh: 为确保高效规划，我们引入了价值引导的图搜索，由一个轻量级Q函数模型在KG上引导蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）。

sentences.en: We theoretically establish bias-consistency for the Q-model and derive sample complexity bounds for path recovery.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上建立了Q模型的偏差一致性，并推导出路径恢复的样本复杂度界。

sentences.en: Empirically, EAM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines like UI-TARS-7B by up to $19.6\%$ on AndroidWorld, while reducing token costs $6\times$ relative to GPT-4o.
sentences.zh: 实验上，EAM在AndroidWorld上比UI-TARS-7B等最先进基线最多高出$19.6\%$，同时相对GPT-4o将令牌成本降低$6\times$。

sentences.en: With a $2.8$s average latency, EAM enables reliable, quick, and long-horizon GUI automation.
sentences.zh: 凭借$2.8$秒的平均延迟，EAM实现了可靠、快速且长时程的GUI自动化。

title_en: ExpAlign: Expectation-Guided Vision–Language Alignment for Open-Vocabulary Grounding
title_zh: ExpAlign：用于开放词汇定位的期望引导视觉语言对齐

sentences.en: Open-vocabulary grounding requires accurate vision-language alignment under weak supervision, yet existing methods either rely on global sentence embeddings that lack fine-grained expressiveness or introduce token-level alignment with explicit supervision or heavy cross-attention designs.
sentences.zh: 开放词汇定位要求在弱监督下实现准确的视觉-语言对齐，然而现有方法要么依赖缺乏细粒度表达能力全局句子嵌入，要么引入需要显式监督或繁重交叉注意设计的词元级对齐。

sentences.en: We propose \textbf{ExpAlign}, a theoretically grounded vision-language alignment framework built on a principled multiple instance learning formulation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了\textbf{ExpAlign}，这是一个在严谨多实例学习框架之上构建的、具有理论基础的视觉-语言对齐框架。

sentences.en: ExpAlign introduces an Expectation Alignment Head that performs attention-based soft MIL pooling over token-region similarities, enabling implicit token and instance selection without additional annotations.
sentences.zh: ExpAlign引入了期望对齐头（Expectation Alignment Head），它对词元-区域相似度执行基于注意力的软MIL池化，从而无需额外标注即可实现隐式的词元与实例选择。

sentences.en: To further stabilize alignment learning, we develop an energy-based multi-scale consistency regularization scheme, including a Top-K multi-positive contrastive objective and a Geometry-Aware Consistency Objective derived from a Lagrangian-constrained free-energy minimization.
sentences.zh: 为进一步稳定对齐学习，我们开发了一种基于能量的多尺度一致性正则化方案，包括一个Top-K多正样本对比目标，以及一个由拉格朗日约束自由能最小化推导出的几何感知一致性目标。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that ExpAlign consistently improves open-vocabulary detection and zero-shot instance segmentation, particularly on long-tail categories.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，ExpAlign持续改进开放词汇检测与零样本实例分割，尤其是在长尾类别上。

sentences.en: Most notably, it achieves 36.2 AP$_r$ on the LVIS minival split, outperforming other state-of-the-art methods at comparable model scale, while remaining lightweight and inference-efficient.
sentences.zh: 最值得注意的是，它在LVIS minival划分上达到36.2 AP_r，在相近模型规模下优于其他最先进方法，同时保持了轻量且推理高效。

title_en: Expand Neurons, Not Parameters
title_zh: 扩展神经元，而非参数

sentences.en: This work demonstrates how increasing the number of neurons in a network without increasing its total number of non-zero parameters improves performance.
sentences.zh: 这项工作展示了如何在网络总非零参数数量不增加的情况下，通过增加神经元数量来提升性能。

sentences.en: We show that this gain corresponds with a decrease in interference between multiple features that would otherwise share the same neurons.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这一增益与多个特征之间干扰的减少相对应，否则这些特征会共享相同的神经元。

sentences.en: On symbolic Boolean tasks, splitting each neuron into sparser sub-neurons with knowledge of the clauses systematically reduces polysemanticity metrics and yields higher task accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在符号布尔任务上，在了解子句的情况下将每个神经元拆分为更稀疏的子神经元，能系统性地降低多义性指标并带来更高的任务准确率。

sentences.en: Notably, even random splits of neuron weights approximate these gains, indicating that reduced collisions, not precise assignment, are a primary driver.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，即使对神经元权重进行随机拆分也能近似达到这些增益，这表明减少冲突而非精确分配才是主要的驱动因素。

sentences.en: Consistent with the superposition hypothesis, the benefits of this framework grow with increasing interference: when polysemantic load is high, accuracy improvements are the largest.
sentences.zh: 与叠加假说一致，该框架的收益随干扰的增加而增大：当多义性负载较高时，准确率提升最大。

sentences.en: Transferring these insights to more realistic models, including classifiers over CLIP embeddings, convolutional neural networks, and deeper multilayer networks, we find that widening networks while maintaining a constant non-zero parameter count consistently increases accuracy.
sentences.zh: 将这些洞见迁移到更接近现实的模型，包括基于CLIP嵌入的分类器、卷积神经网络以及更深的层网络结构，我们发现，在保持非零参数数量恒定的同时加宽网络，能持续提升准确率。

sentences.en: These results identify an interpretability-grounded mechanism to leverage width against superposition, improving performance without increasing the number of non-zero parameters.
sentences.zh: 这些结果识别出一种基于可解释性的机制，用以利用宽度对抗叠加效应，从而在不增加非零参数数量的情况下提升性能。

sentences.en: Such a direction is well matched to modern accelerators, where memory movement of non-zero parameters, rather than raw compute, is often a dominant bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 这一方向与现代加速器高度契合，因为在这些加速器中，非零参数的内存移动（而非原始计算）往往是主要瓶颈。

title_en: Expandable, Compressible, Mineable: Open-World Thermal Infrared Image Restoration
title_zh: 可扩展、可压缩、可挖掘：开放世界热红外图像恢复

sentences.en: In open-world settings, thermal infrared (TIR) image degradations continuously emerge and evolve, while most existing all-in-one restoration methods are built on a closed-set assumption and struggle to continually adapt to novel degradations.
sentences.zh: 在开放世界场景中，热红外（TIR）图像的退化会不断出现并演化，而现有的大多数一体化复原方法都建立在闭集假设之上，难以持续适应新的退化类型。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose ECMRNet, an Expandable, Compressible, and Mineable Restoration Network for open-world TIR restoration from a continual learning perspective.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们从持续学习的视角提出 ECMRNet，一种面向开放世界 TIR 复原的可扩展、可压缩、可挖掘的复原网络。

sentences.en: Conceptually, ECMRNet unifies continual degradation learning as an "expand–compress–mine" closed-loop process, enabling sustained adaptation to new degradations with controllable evolution.
sentences.zh: 在概念上，ECMRNet 将持续的退化学习统一为“扩展—压缩—挖掘”的闭环过程，从而能以可控的演化实现对新型退化的持续适应。

sentences.en: Structurally, ECMRNet decomposes intermediate representations into group-isolated subspaces, and achieves strict parameter isolation and fast adaptation to new degradations by freezing historical groups and isomorphically expanding new ones.
sentences.zh: 在结构上，ECMRNet 将中间表示分解为组隔离的子空间，通过冻结历史组并同构地扩展新组，实现严格的参数隔离和对新型退化的快速适应。

sentences.en: To curb model growth as tasks accumulate, we present Structural Entropy Pruning, which identifies and removes redundant channel groups via two-dimensional structural entropy minimization, achieving information contribution–driven adaptive compression.
sentences.zh: 为抑制模型随任务积累而不断膨胀，我们提出结构熵剪枝，通过二维结构熵最小化识别并移除冗余的通道组，实现由信息贡献驱动的自适应压缩。

sentences.en: Moreover, we design a Sub-degradation Knowledge Mining Module that dynamically retrieves and recombines transferable components from historical representations to improve restoration under compound degradations.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们设计了一个子退化知识挖掘模块，从历史表示中动态检索并重组可迁移组件，以改善复合退化下的复原效果。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that ECMRNet achieves superior overall performance across diverse single and compound degradations while using fewer parameters and lower computational cost.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，ECMRNet 在多种单一与复合退化上取得了优越的整体性能，同时使用的参数更少、计算成本更低。

title_en: Expanding the AI Evaluation Toolbox with Statistical Models
title_zh: 利用统计模型扩展 AI 评估工具箱

sentences.en: Benchmarks are widely used to evaluate and compare the performance of artificial intelligence systems.
sentences.zh: 基准测试被广泛用于评估和比较人工智能系统的性能。

sentences.en: However, some approaches to computing benchmark metrics produce invalid uncertainty estimates or make unrecognized assumptions about the evaluation setting.
sentences.zh: 然而，一些计算基准指标的方法会产生无效的不确定性估计，或对评估设定作出未被识别的假设。

sentences.en: We leverage statistical modeling to make two contributions to the practice of AI benchmarking.
sentences.zh: 我们利用统计建模为AI基准测试实践作出两项贡献。

sentences.en: First, we formally distinguish measurements of benchmark accuracy from generalized accuracy (performance on all potential test items similar to those included in the benchmark).
sentences.zh: 首先，我们形式化地区分了基准准确率的度量与广义准确率（即在所有与基准中包含的题目相似的可能测试题上的性能）。

sentences.en: Then, in a simulated setting and with large-scale evaluation of 22 API-access frontier large language models on 3 popular benchmarks, we show how analysis via generalized linear mixed model can produce correct estimates of generalized accuracy while more efficiently quantifying uncertainty compared to existing regression-free approaches.
sentences.zh: 接着，在模拟设定以及针对3个流行基准上22个API访问型前沿大语言模型的大规模评估中，我们展示了如何通过广义线性混合模型的分析产生正确的广义准确率估计，同时与现有的无回归方法相比更高效地量化不确定性。

sentences.en: We also show how this approach can equip evaluators with important context on evaluation results, including variance decomposition and item difficulty estimates that illuminate important aspects of LLM performance and benchmark construction.
sentences.zh: 我们还展示了这一方法如何为评估者提供关于评估结果的重要背景，包括方差分解与题目难度估计，从而揭示LLM性能与基准构建的重要方面。

title_en: Expanding the Capabilities of Reinforcement Learning via Text Feedback
title_zh: 通过文本反馈扩展强化学习能力

sentences.en: The success of RL for LLM post-training stems from an unreasonably uninformative source: a single bit of information per rollout as binary reward or preference label.
sentences.zh: RL用于LLM后训练的成功源自一个极不合理的信息源：每次rollout仅有一位信息，即二元奖励或偏好标签。

sentences.en: At the other extreme, distillation offers dense supervision but requires demonstrations, which are costly and difficult to scale.
sentences.zh: 在另一个极端，蒸馏提供密集的监督，但需要演示数据，而演示数据成本高昂且难以规模化。

sentences.en: We study natural language feedback as an intermediate signal: richer than scalar rewards, yet cheaper than complete demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 我们研究将自然语言反馈作为一种中间信号：它比标量奖励更丰富，又比完整演示更廉价。

sentences.en: Textual feedback is a natural mode of human interaction and is already abundant in many real-world settings, where users, tools, and automated judges routinely critique LLM outputs.
sentences.zh: 文本反馈是人类交互的一种自然方式，在许多真实场景中已经十分丰富，在这些场景中，用户、工具与自动化评审者经常对LLM的输出提出批评。

sentences.en: Towards leveraging text feedback at scale, we formalize a multi-turn RL setup where text feedback is available during training but not at inference.
sentences.zh: 为在规模化层面上利用文本反馈，我们形式化了一种多轮RL设定，其中反馈在训练期间可用，但在推理时不可用。

sentences.en: Therefore, models must learn to internalize the feedback in order to improve their test-time single-turn performance.
sentences.zh: 因此，模型必须学会内化反馈，以提升其在测试时的单轮性能。

sentences.en: To do this, we propose two methods: Self Distillation, which trains the single-turn policy to match its own feedback-conditioned second-turn generations; and Feedback Modeling, which predicts the feedback as an auxiliary objective.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出两种方法：自我蒸馏（Self Distillation），它训练单轮策略以匹配其自身带反馈条件的第二轮生成；以及反馈建模（Feedback Modeling），它将预测反馈作为辅助目标。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical analysis on both methods, and empirically evaluate on reasoning puzzles, competition math, and creative writing tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们对这两种方法进行了理论分析，并在推理谜题、竞赛数学与创意写作任务上进行了实证评估。

sentences.en: Our results show that both methods consistently outperform strong baselines across benchmarks, highlighting the potential of RL with an additional source of rich supervision at scale.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，这两种方法在多个基准上都持续优于强基线，凸显了RL在规模化层面上利用丰富监督额外来源的潜力。

title_en: Expanding the Chaos: Neural Operator for Stochastic (Partial) Differential Equations
title_zh: 扩展混沌：用于随机微分方程及随机偏微分方程的神经算子

sentences.en: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) and stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs) are fundamental for modeling stochastic dynamics across the natural sciences and modern machine learning.
sentences.zh: 随机微分方程（SDE）与随机偏微分方程（SPDE）是自然科学和现代机器学习中对随机动力学进行建模的基础。

sentences.en: Learning their solution operators with deep learning models promises fast solvers and new perspectives on classical learning tasks.
sentences.zh: 用深度学习模型学习它们的解算子，有望提供快速求解器，并为经典学习任务带来新的视角。

sentences.en: In this work, we build on Wiener--chaos expansions (WCE) to design neural operator (NO) architectures for SDEs and SPDEs: we project driving noise paths onto orthonormal Wick--Hermite features and use NO backbones to parameterize the corresponding chaos coefficients governed by deterministic equations, enabling reconstruction of S(P)DE solutions from the observed noise trajectories.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们基于Wiener-chaos展开（WCE）来为SDE与SPDE设计神经算子（NO）架构：我们将驱动噪声路径投影到正交Wick-Hermite特征上，并利用NO主干对由确定性方程控制的相应chaos系数进行参数化，从而能够从观测到的噪声轨迹重建S(P)DE的解。

sentences.en: Empirically, we achieve competitive accuracy across several tasks, including standard SPDE benchmarks and SDE-based diffusion one-step image sampling, topological graph interpolation, financial extrapolation, parameter estimation, and manifold SDE flood forecasting.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，我们在多项任务中达到了有竞争力的精度，包括标准SPDE基准、基于SDE扩散的单步图像采样、拓扑图插值、金融外推、参数估计以及流形SDE洪水预测。

sentences.en: We further explore a law-matching setting where the Brownian trajectories paired with training solutions are unobserved, and show that the proposed framework remains effective by sampling auxiliary Brownian paths from the prescribed noise prior.
sentences.zh: 我们还探索了一种定律匹配设定，其中与训练解配对的布朗轨迹不可观测，并表明通过从规定的噪声先验中采样辅助布朗路径，所提出的框架依然有效。

sentences.en: These results suggest WCE-based neural operators are a practical and scalable approach to learning SDE/SPDE solution operators across domains.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，基于WCE的神经算子是跨领域学习SDE/SPDE解算子的一种实用且可扩展的方法。

sentences.en: Our source code can be found in https://github.com/EEthanShi/SDENO.
sentences.zh: 我们的源代码可在 https://github.com/EEthanShi/SDENO 查看。

title_en: Expectation Alignment of Language Models for Real-World User Expectations
title_zh: 使语言模型与真实用户期望对齐

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on standard benchmarks, yet it remains largely unexplored whether they truly meet user expectations.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在标准基准上展现出卓越性能，但它们是否真正满足用户期望，在很大程度上仍未被探索。

sentences.en: Existing evaluation approaches, relying on model heuristics, expert rubrics, or user simulation, fail to capture the diversity and subtlety of real human expectations, causing models to appear competent while misaligning with what users actually seek. we present the first systematic study of user expectations in real-world LLM interactions, proposing a principled procedure to extract semantically rich expectations and introducing ExpectBench, a benchmark grounded in real user expectations.
sentences.zh: 现有的评估方法依赖模型启发式、专家评分规则或用户模拟，无法捕获真实人类期望的多样性与微妙之处，导致模型看似胜任，却与用户真正追求的目标不一致。我们提出了首个针对真实世界LLM交互中用户期望的系统性研究，提出了一套提取语义丰富期望的严谨流程，并引入了基于真实用户期望的基准ExpectBench。

sentences.en: Analyses reveal that current LLMs struggle to satisfy and anticipate what users hope to obtain, highlighting a fundamental source of misalignment.
sentences.zh: 分析表明，当前LLM难以满足并预判用户希望获得的内容，凸显出一个根本性的错位来源。

sentences.en: Building on these observations, we propose LENS, a lightweight latent expectation–aware response generation framework.
sentences.zh: 基于这些观察，我们提出了LENS，一个轻量级的潜在期望感知的响应生成框架。

sentences.en: LENS enables models to internalize user expectations and generate better-aligned responses, consistently improving expectation satisfaction and underscoring the importance of explicitly modeling user expectations for realistic human–AI alignment.
sentences.zh: LENS使模型能够内化用户期望并生成更对齐的响应，持续提升期望满足度，并凸显了为现实的人机对齐显式建模用户期望的重要性。

title_en: Expectation Consistency Loss: Rethink Confidence Calibration under Covariate Shift
title_zh: 期望一致性损失：重新思考协变量偏移下的置信度校准

sentences.en: Confidence calibration for classification models is vital in safety-critical decision-making scenarios and has received extensive attention.
sentences.zh: 分类模型的置信度校准在安全攸关的决策场景中至关重要，并已受到广泛关注。

sentences.en: General confidence calibration methods assume training and test data are independent and identically distributed ($i.i.d.$), limiting their effectiveness under covariate shifts.
sentences.zh: 一般的置信度校准方法假设训练与测试数据独立同分布（$i.i.d.$），这限制了它们在协变量偏移下的有效性。

sentences.en: Previous calibration methods under covariate shift struggle with class-wise or canonical calibrations and often rely on unstable importance weighting when density ratios are large or unbounded.
sentences.zh: 以往协变量偏移下的校准方法在类别级或规范校准上存在困难，并且在密度比过大或无界时，往往依赖不稳定的重要性加权。

sentences.en: Given the above limitations, this paper rethinks confidence calibration under covariate shifts.
sentences.zh: 鉴于上述局限，本文重新思考协变量偏移下的置信度校准。

sentences.en: First, we derive a necessary and sufficient condition for confidence calibration under covariate shifts, named Expectation consistency condition, which reveals covariate shifts do not necessarily lead to uncalibrated confidence and provides a weaker condition for confidence calibration than global covariate distribution alignment.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们推导出协变量偏移下置信度校准的一个充要条件，称为期望一致性条件，它揭示了协变量偏移并不必然导致置信度失校准，并为置信度校准提供了一个比全局协变量分布对齐更弱的条件。

sentences.en: Then, utilizing Expectation consistency condition, this paper proposes an unsupervised domain adaptation loss to calibrate confidence of the target domain, named Expectation consistency loss (ECL), which is compatible with canonical calibration, class-wise calibration, and top-label calibration.
sentences.zh: 然后，利用期望一致性条件，本文提出了一种无监督域适应损失来校准目标域的置信度，称为期望一致性损失（ECL），它与规范校准、类别级校准和顶层标签校准均兼容。

sentences.en: Third, we prove that computing ECL loss has the same sample complexity as Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and provide a theoretically grounded mini-batch trainable scheme for ECL loss.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们证明计算ECL损失的样本复杂度与期望校准误差（ECE）相同，并为ECL损失提供了具有理论依据的小批量可训练方案。

sentences.en: Finally, we validate the effectiveness of our method on both simulated and real-world covariate shift datasets.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在模拟与真实世界的协变量偏移数据集上验证了我们方法的有效性。

title_en: Expected Return Causes Outcome-Level Mode Collapse in Reinforcement Learning and How to Fix It with Inverse Probability Scaling
title_zh: 期望回报导致强化学习中结果层面的模式坍缩，以及如何利用逆概率缩放修复

sentences.en: Many reinforcement learning (RL) problems admit multiple terminal solutions of comparable quality, where the goal is not to identify a single optimum but to represent a diverse set of high-quality outcomes.
sentences.zh: 许多强化学习（RL）问题存在多个质量相当的最终止解，其目标并非找出单一最优，而是要表示一组多样化的高质量结果。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, policies trained by standard expected-return maximization routinely collapse onto a small subset of outcomes, a phenomenon commonly attributed to insufficient exploration or weak regularization.
sentences.zh: 然而，由标准期望回报最大化训练出的策略通常会坍缩到一小部分结果上，这一现象通常被归因于探索不足或正则化较弱。

sentences.en: We show that this explanation is incomplete: outcome-level mode collapse is a structural consequence of the expected-return objective itself.
sentences.zh: 我们表明这一解释并不完整：结果级模式坍缩是期望回报目标本身的结构性结果。

sentences.en: Under idealized learning dynamics, the log-probability ratio between any two outcomes evolves linearly in their reward difference, implying exponential ratio divergence and inevitable collapse—independent of the exploration strategy, entropy regularization, or optimization algorithm.
sentences.zh: 在理想化学习动态下，任意两个结果之间的对数概率比随它们的奖励差线性演变，这意味着指数级比值发散与不可避免的坍缩——这与探索策略、熵正则化或优化算法都无关。

sentences.en: We identify the source of this pathology as the probability multiplier inside the expectation and propose a minimal correction: inverse probability scaling, which removes outcome-frequency amplification from the learning signal, fundamentally changes the learning dynamics, and provably yields reward-proportional terminal distributions, preventing collapse in multimodal settings.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一病理的根源识别为期望内部的概率乘子，并提出一种最小修正：逆概率缩放，它从学习信号中移除结果频率放大，从根本上改变学习动态，并可证明地产生与奖励成比例的终止分布，从而在多种模式设定下防止坍缩。

sentences.en: We instantiate this principle in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as a drop-in modification, IPS-GRPO, requiring no auxiliary models or architectural changes.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一原则实例化到组相对策略优化（GRPO）中，作为即插即用的修改IPS-GRPO，无需任何辅助模型或架构改动。

sentences.en: Across different reasoning and molecular generation tasks, IPS-GRPO consistently reduces outcome-level mode collapse while matching or exceeding baseline performance, suggesting that correcting the objective rather than adding exploration heuristics is key to reliable multimodal policy optimization.
sentences.zh: 在多种推理与分子生成任务中，IPS-GRPO在匹配或超越基线性能的同时，持续降低结果级模式坍缩，这表明修正目标而非添加探索启发式，才是实现可靠多模式策略优化的关键。

title_en: Expected Returns and Policy Inconsistency-Aware Offline Federated Deep Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 感知期望回报与策略不一致性的离线联邦深度强化学习

sentences.en: Offline Federated Deep Reinforcement Learning (FDRL) methods aggregate multiple client-side offline Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) models, each trained locally, to facilitate knowledge sharing while preserving privacy.
sentences.zh: 离线联邦深度强化学习（FDRL）方法聚合多个客户端本地训练的离线深度强化学习（DRL）模型，以便在保护隐私的同时促进知识共享。

sentences.en: Existing offline FDRL methods assign client weights during global aggregation using either simple averaging or Q-values, but they neglect the combined consideration of Q-values and policy inconsistency, the latter of which reflects the distributional discrepancy between the learned policy and the policy from offline data.
sentences.zh: 现有的离线FDRL方法在全局聚合时使用简单平均或Q值来分配客户端权重，但它们忽略了Q值与策略不一致性的综合考虑，后者反映了学习策略与离线数据策略之间的分布差异。

sentences.en: This causes clients with no significant advantages in one aspect but obvious disadvantages in the other to disproportionately affect the global model, thereby degrading its capabilities in that aspect.
sentences.zh: 这导致在某一维度无明显优势但在另一维度存在明显劣势的客户端对全局模型产生不成比例的影响，从而削弱全局模型在该维度上的能力。

sentences.en: During local training, clients in existing methods are compelled to fully adopt the global model, which negatively impacts clients when the global model is weak.
sentences.zh: 在本地训练期间，现有方法中的客户端被迫完全采纳全局模型，这会在全局模型较弱时对客户端产生负面影响。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose a novel Federated Learning (FL) framework that can be seamlessly integrated into current offline FDRL approaches to improve their performance.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了一种新颖的联邦学习（FL）框架，它可以无缝集成到当前离线FDRL方法中以提升其性能。

sentences.en: Our method considers both policy inconsistency and Q-values to determine the weights of client models, with the latter adjusted by a scaling factor to avoid significant numerical discrepancies with the former.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法同时考虑策略不一致性与Q值来确定客户端模型的权重，并通过缩放因子调整后者，以避免与前者出现显著的数值差异。

sentences.en: The aggregated global model is then distributed to clients to facilitate their learning from the global model.
sentences.zh: 随后，聚合得到的全局模型被分发给客户端，以促进它们从全局模型中学习。

sentences.en: The impact of the global model on the local models is reduced when a client's model performance exceeds that of the global model, thereby mitigating the influence of a weaker global model.
sentences.zh: 当某客户端的模型性能超过全局模型时，全局模型对本地模型的影响会被降低，从而减轻较弱全局模型的影响。

sentences.en: Experiments on the Datasets for Deep Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning (D4RL) demonstrate that our method improves seven state-of-the-art (SOTA) offline FDRL methods across several metrics.
sentences.zh: 在深度数据驱动强化学习数据集（D4RL）上的实验表明，我们的方法在多项指标上改进了七种最先进的（SOTA）离线FDRL方法。

title_en: Experience Augmented Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
title_zh: 用于大语言模型推理的经验增强策略优化

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的强大范式。

sentences.en: However, existing RLVR methods typically rely on on-policy optimization from scratch, resulting in high sampling costs and inefficient utilization of accumulated experience.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的RLVR方法通常依赖从零开始的在策略优化，导致高采样成本与对累积经验的低效利用。

sentences.en: As model capabilities and policy behaviors evolve during training, recent attempts to reuse experience via fixed reasoning trajectories further suffer from policy mismatch.
sentences.zh: 由于训练过程中模型能力与策略行为不断演变，近期通过固定推理轨迹重用经验的尝试进一步遭受策略不匹配的困扰。

sentences.en: Motivated by these limitations, we argue that experience in RLVR should not be reused as fixed reasoning trajectories, but instead expressed in a policy-adaptive manner.
sentences.zh: 受这些局限的启发，我们认为RLVR中的经验不应被当作固定推理轨迹来重用，而应以策略自适应的方式来表达。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Experience-Augmented Policy Optimization (EAPO), which leverages a prior RL-optimized policy as an action-level experience prior and selectively injects experience at critical decision points during rollout.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出经验增强策略优化（EAPO），它将一个先前的RL优化策略作为动作级经验先验，并在rollout过程中选择性地在关键决策点注入经验。

sentences.en: To ensure stable and unbiased learning from experience-augmented rollouts, EAPO further incorporates an adapted importance sampling scheme.
sentences.zh: 为确保从经验增强的rollout中进行稳定且无偏的学习，EAPO还整合了一种改编的重要性采样方案。

sentences.en: Experiments on using Qwen-2.5-math 7b and Qwen-3-8B on five different benchmarks demonstrate that EAPO consistently improves reasoning performance over state-of-the-art RLVR methods.
sentences.zh: 在使用Qwen-2.5-math 7b和Qwen-3-8B于五个不同基准上的实验中，EAPO在推理性能上持续优于最先进的RLVR方法。

title_en: Experience is the Best Teacher: Motivating Effective Exploration in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
title_zh: 经验是最好的老师：激励大语言模型强化学习中的有效探索

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) with rubric-based rewards has recently shown remarkable progress in enhancing general reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet still suffers from ineffective exploration confined to current policy distribution.
sentences.zh: 基于评分规则奖励的强化学习（RL）近期在增强大语言模型（LLM）的一般推理能力方面取得了显著进展，但仍受困于局限于当前策略分布的无效探索。

sentences.en: In fact, RL optimization can be viewed as steering the policy toward an ideal distribution that maximizes the rewards, while effective exploration should align efforts with desired target.
sentences.zh: 事实上，RL优化可以视为将策略引向一个最大化奖励的理想分布，而有效的探索应将努力与期望目标对齐。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we propose HeRL, a ****H***indsight ***e***xperience guided ***R***einforcement ***L***earning*  framework to bootstrap effective exploration by explicitly *telling LLMs the desired behaviors* specified in rewards.
sentences.zh: 利用这一洞见，我们提出了HeRL，一个***后**见***经***验引导的***强***化***学***习框架，通过明确地*告诉LLM奖励中所指定的期望行为*来启动有效的探索。

sentences.en: Concretely, HeRL treats failed attempts along with their unmet rubrics as hindsight experience, which serves as in-context guidance for the policy to explore desired responses beyond its current distribution.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，HeRL将失败的尝试及其未满足的评分规则视为后见经验，它们充当策略在超出当前分布之外探索期望响应的上下文引导。

sentences.en: Additionally, we introduce a bonus reward to incentivize responses with greater potential for improvement under such guidance.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入了一种奖励加成，以激励在此类引导下具有更大改进潜力的响应。

sentences.en: HeRL facilitates effective learning from desired high-quality samples without repeated trial-and-error from scratch, yielding a more accurate estimation of the expected gradient theoretically.
sentences.zh: HeRL无需从头反复试错，即可从期望的高质量样本中进行有效学习，在理论上产生对期望梯度更准确的估计。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across various benchmarks demonstrate that HeRL achieves superior performance gains over baselines, and can further benefit from experience guided self-improvement at test time.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，HeRL相比基线取得了更优的性能提升，并且能进一步受益于测试时经验引导的自我改进。

title_en: Experience-Evolving Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agent with Hybrid Episodic–Procedural Memory
title_zh: 结合情景–过程混合记忆的经验演化多轮工具使用智能体

sentences.en: As intents unfold and environments change, multi-turn agents face continuously shifting decision contexts.
sentences.zh: 随着意图不断展开、环境不断变化，多轮智能体面临持续变化的决策情境。

sentences.en: Although reusing past experience is intuitively appealing, existing approaches remain limited: full trajectories are often too context-specific to transfer, while tool-level reuse ignores the context and environment.
sentences.zh: 尽管重用过往经验直觉上很有吸引力，但现有方法仍存在局限：完整轨迹往往过于依赖具体情境而难以迁移，而工具级重用则忽视了情境与环境。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce a hybrid episodic–procedural memory strategy (H-EPM) that enables experience-evolution of multi-turn tool-use policies, by adaptively reusing partially overlapping successful experiences in both inference and training.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入了一种混合情景-程序记忆策略（H-EPM），通过在推理与训练中自适应地重用部分重叠的成功经验，实现多轮工具使用策略的经验演化。

sentences.en: Inspired by human episodic–procedural integration, we build a tool graph from accumulated trajectories, where recurring tool-to-tool dependencies capture procedural routines and each edge is augmented with a compact episodic summaries of relevant context.
sentences.zh: 受人类情景-程序整合的启发，我们从累积的轨迹中构建一个工具图，其中反复出现的工具间依赖捕获程序化例程，每条边都附有相关情境的紧凑情景摘要。

sentences.en: At inference, the agent dynamically balances episodic recall for contextual reasoning and procedural execution for routine steps.
sentences.zh: 在推理时，智能体动态地在用于情境推理的情景回放与用于例行步骤的程序执行之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Beyond inference, H-EPM introduces a memory-guided reinforcement learning paradigm that directly addresses a core challenge in multi-turn agent RL: ineffective exploration over long trajectories.
sentences.zh: 除了推理之外，H-EPM还引入了一种记忆引导的强化学习范式，直接应对多轮智能体RL中的一个核心挑战：在长轨迹上的无效探索。

sentences.en: By biasing exploration toward historically successful tool transitions, H-EPM learns a stronger policy that generalizes during inference without relying on domain-specific experience collection.
sentences.zh: 通过将探索偏向历史上成功的工具转移，H-EPM学习到一个更强的策略，能够在推理期间推广，而无需依赖特定领域的经验收集。

sentences.en: Experiments show that H-EPM consistently delivers substantial inference-time gains over strong baselines across multi-turn tool-use benchmarks, reaching up to 50%+.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，H-EPM在多轮工具使用基准上持续显著超过强基线，推理时增益最高可达50%以上。

sentences.en: It also boosts RL policy performance, achieving up to 40%+ improvement on out-of-distribution tasks.
sentences.zh: 它还提升了RL策略性能，在分布外任务上实现了高达40%以上的改进。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/LISijia-dev/H-EPM.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/LISijia-dev/H-EPM 获取。
